title: Ultimate Custom Run
description: Customize your custom runs! Choose the card Specialized adds: select one available card from your character's pool and receive five copies. New modifier: Neow!! — Brings back starter Neow relic choice. Other modifier effects resolve first, followed by the normal starter relic offers. No BaseLib dependency. Built against Slay the Spire 2 v0.111.0. Gameplay mod: every co-op player needs it. Managed integration tests passed; in-game UI and co-op have not been playtested.
changeNote: 1.1.1: Fixed fatal startup error caused by duplicate registration of the Neow!! modifier.
